passage.label: Has there come upon man period time when not thing mentioned; Indeed created man sperm-drop mixture may try him made hearing seeing; Indeed guided him way be grateful or ungrateful; Indeed prepared disbelievers chains shackles blaze

arabicExcerpts.text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ حِينٞ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـٔٗا مَّذۡكُورًا
إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجٖ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا
إِنَّا هَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرٗا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَاْ وَأَغۡلَٰلٗا وَسَعِيرًا

mainSubject.label: Man's prior non-existence recalled before his creation from a sperm-drop mixture for the purpose of trial, endowed with hearing and sight; guidance shown to him leaving him either grateful or ungrateful; chains, shackles and a blaze prepared for the disbelievers

notes: Wave 11 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the disbelievers' chains-shackles-blaze preparation (4) before the righteous-reward block opens (5); P2 ends with the earned-reward declaration (22) before the progressive-Quran and prophetic-instruction block begins (23); P3 covers the tanzil, patience command, dhikr and night worship (23-26); P4 runs through the immediate-love diagnosis, creation-alteration power, reminder function, divine-will nesting and closing mercy-punishment distinction (27-31).
